true-black.$description: True Black — Primary canvas, hero background, nav backdrop, full-page surface

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Elevated card surfaces on dark mode, section dividers, body text on light surfaces

smoke.$description: Smoke — Nav segment bar, secondary button fills, subtle tonal contrast on dark backgrounds

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body text, navigation labels, and subdued headings. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Muted body text, meta labels, input borders, helper copy

platinum.$description: Platinum — Icon fills, nav glyphs, decorative outlines at low contrast

silk.$description: Silk — Primary heading and body text on dark backgrounds, light surface fills, badge backgrounds

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Maximum contrast text, icon fills, light card surfaces, button text

apple-blue.$description: Apple Blue — Primary purchase CTA fill — the single chromatic action button, Buy button, focus ring

link-blue.$description: Link Blue — Blue text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-link.$description: Deep Link — Standard body link color, secondary anchor text

ember.$description: Ember — New badge accent — small warm punctuation for freshness markers

m5-spectrum-gradient.$description: M5 Spectrum Gradient — Decorative gradient endpoint — product chip badge backgrounds with prismatic color washes

sf-pro-display.$description: Subheadings, card titles, eyebrow labels — transitions from display to functional type. Tracking shifts to slightly positive values (+0.007em at 28px, +0.012em at 19px) as size decreases, compensating for optical tightness in shorter strings.

sf-pro-text.$description: Logo and brand mark rendering size in the global nav — weight 400 not 600, because the wordmark itself carries the form. Line-height 1.00 keeps it visually compact.
